Hi Ben —

Thanks again for offering to run a geo-adjusted benchmark for us. We want to validate whether our current comp bands should be adjusted for EU and APAC hires and to define a simple geo multiplier approach (region buckets) for offer guidance. Key asks: 

- Market percentile targets by level (IC3–IC6) across US / EU (major hubs) / APAC (IN, SG)
- Cost-of-living / purchasing-power rough multipliers you recommend for offer decisions
- Any suggested adjustments to long-term incentive (LTI) philosophy when bands change
- A concise recommended band table we can drop into the hiring playbook

Attached is our current matrix (proposed_comp_matrix_v2.xlsx) and a short note on how recruiting currently sets offers. If possible we need a deliverable by Feb 18 — we have two EU offers scheduled week of Feb 23 and want consistent guidance.

Thanks —
Hannah

Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 14:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: geo bands + benchmark data

Hannah —

Appended our findings and a short set of recommended band adjustments. Main takeaways (see attached PDF for detail):

1) Recommended region buckets: US-Major (SF/NY), US-Other, EU-Major (LDN/BER/AMS), EU-Other, APAC-Major (SG/SYD), APAC-Other (IN).
2) For IC3–IC4 we recommend keeping target at 50th market percentile; for IC5 target 55th; for IC6 (senior IC) 60th to help source scarce talent.
3) Geo multipliers vs US-Major (baseline): EU-Major -0.04 to -0.08, EU-Other -0.10 to -0.15, APAC-Major -0.05 to -0.12 (IN larger variance). These are market-level guidance not prescriptive.
4) LTI guidance: keep LTI alignment % by level, but shift a greater portion to cash sign-on in high-differential markets in the near-term.

Attached: radford_geo_benchmarks_Q1_2026.pdf (summary + tables) and a spreadsheet with percentile numbers.

If helpful I can prepare a trimmed ‘offer cheat sheet’ for recruiters.

Best,
Ben Cole
Senior Consultant, Radford Compensation Consulting
[Attachment: radford_geo_benchmarks_Q1_2026.pdf (pdf)]
